body:
Reported on 1.14.0 (web, and the same layout wanted on Android). On the balances
view the title is "Balances" and does not lead back; the user is not happy with that
layout, and on the expense view nothing says that the summary card opens balances.

Wanted: the normal list header on both views, as on the other lists (all-lists link,
list name), and under it a selector switching between the two views. The user
suggested "overview | balances"; labelled Expenses | Balances instead, because
"Overview" already names the all-lists screen in both clients.
title: expense lists: one header for both views, with an Expenses | Balances selector
